skill.name: data-scientist
skill.description: Expert data scientist guidance for analytics, machine learning, statistical modeling, visualization, and business intelligence workflows.
skill.summary: Guides data science analysis from problem framing through modeling, validation, and stakeholder-ready recommendations.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only SKILL.md file. Manual review found no executable code, prompt injection attempt, credential access, network behavior, or data-exfiltration intent.

content.user_title: Analyze Data With Data Science Guidance
content.value_statement: Data teams need structured guidance for statistics, machine learning, and business reporting. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code plan analyses, validate methods, and explain actionable findings.
actual_capabilities: Guides exploratory data analysis with summaries, distributions, correlations, missing values, and outlier checks.
Recommends statistical methods for hypothesis testing, experiments, causal inference, forecasting, and survival analysis.
Helps plan machine learning workflows, including feature engineering, model selection, validation, and interpretation.
Supports business analytics for marketing, finance, operations, segmentation, churn, fraud, and demand forecasting.
Suggests visualization and communication approaches for technical reports, dashboards, and executive summaries.
Covers production model topics such as monitoring, drift detection, governance, and deployment planning.
limitations: It does not execute analysis, train models, or access datasets by itself.
It depends on user-provided data context, assumptions, constraints, and success criteria.
It cannot replace domain expert review for regulated, financial, medical, or legal decisions.
Its recommendations still require validation in the target environment before use.

use_cases.title: Plan a Predictive Modeling Project
use_cases.description: Define the target, features, validation strategy, metrics, and deployment considerations for a supervised learning workflow.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Experiment Results
use_cases.description: Choose statistical tests, estimate effect sizes, check assumptions, and translate experiment results into business recommendations.

use_cases.title: Create Executive Data Stories
use_cases.description: Turn analysis findings into clear visuals, caveats, decisions, and next steps for non-technical stakeholders.

prompt_templates.title: Start an Analysis Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for structured project guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a data science analysis for [business question]. The available data includes [fields]. Ask for any missing context first.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Statistical Methods
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend statistical methods for testing whether [change] affected [metric]. Include assumptions, sample size concerns, and interpretation guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Modeling Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for machine learning planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a predictive modeling workflow for [target outcome]. Cover feature engineering, validation, metrics, bias checks, interpretability, and monitoring.

prompt_templates.title: Review an End-to-End Study
prompt_templates.scenario: Expert request for critique and production readiness.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this data science approach for [project]. Identify statistical risks, data leakage, model governance gaps, and stakeholder communication improvements.

output_examples.input: Plan a churn prediction project for a subscription business.
output_examples.output: A project plan with target definition, cohort rules, feature groups, validation windows, model options, evaluation metrics, and deployment checks.

output_examples.input: Analyze whether a checkout redesign improved conversion.
output_examples.output: An experiment review covering test design, metric choice, significance testing, effect size, guardrail metrics, caveats, and a decision recommendation.

output_examples.input: Summarize customer segmentation results for executives.
output_examples.output: A stakeholder-ready narrative with segment profiles, business value, recommended actions, data limitations, and follow-up analysis steps.

best_practices: Provide the business objective, dataset scope, metric definitions, and decision criteria before asking for recommendations.
Ask for assumptions, validation checks, and limitations when the analysis affects business or customer decisions.
Request both technical detail and stakeholder-ready summaries when sharing results with mixed audiences.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a model recommendation without explaining the target, data, constraints, and deployment context.
Do not treat statistical significance as business significance without effect size and practical impact.
Do not skip data leakage, bias, privacy, and reproducibility checks before using model outputs.

faq.question: Can this skill analyze my dataset directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and review based on the data details, summaries, and outputs you share.

faq.question: Which tools does this skill support?
faq.answer: It is marked as compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it help with machine learning model selection?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare model families, validation strategies, metrics, interpretability needs, and monitoring requirements.

faq.question: Can it support A/B testing and causal analysis?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers experiment design, hypothesis testing, power analysis, causal inference, and result interpretation.

faq.question: Is it suitable for executive reporting?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help convert technical findings into concise recommendations, visuals, caveats, and next steps.

faq.question: Does it replace expert review?
faq.answer: No. High-impact or regulated decisions still require expert validation and environment-specific testing.
